brief:
Jerusalem Electricity Company announced a temporary halt to meter charging and bill payment operations across all its branches, offices, and authorized charging centers, the Ma'an news agency reported. The suspension also affects self-service machines, the company's application, and the E-SADAD platform on banking and digital wallet apps.

The company attributed the stoppage to upgrade work, though it did not specify the duration of the interruption or provide additional details about the maintenance operations.

title: Jerusalem Electricity Company suspends meter charging and bill payments
